cases.explain: «человеческом сердце» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

cases.explain: «неверные гири» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

cases.explain: «драгоценных камней» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

cases.explain: «Мудрый царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
